mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BUY_DETAIL (BOOK_NUM, BUY_CNT, BUY_PRICE, BUY_NUM) VALUES (#{bookNum}, #{buyCnt}, #{buyPrice}, #{buyNum})
mapper.select: SELECT B.BUY_NUM, B.BUY_PRICE, B.MEM_EMAIL, B.BUY_DATE, D.BUY_DETAIL_NUM, D.BOOK_NUM, D.BUY_CNT, D.BUY_PRICE AS DETAIL_PRICE, D.BUY_NUM, BK.BOOK_TITLE, BK.BOOK_PRICE, I.UPLOAD_FILE_NAME FROM SHOP_BUY B LEFT JOIN BUY_DETAIL D ON D.buy_num = B.buy_num LEFT JOIN SHOP_BOOK BK ON D.BOOK_NUM = BK.BOOK_NUM LEFT JOIN BOOK_IMG I ON BK.BOOK_NUM = I.BOOK_NUM AND I.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE B.MEM_EMAIL = #{memEmail} ORDER BY B.BUY_DATE DESC

SELECT B.BUY_NUM, B.BUY_PRICE, B.MEM_EMAIL, B.BUY_DATE, D.BUY_DETAIL_NUM, D.BOOK_NUM, D.BUY_PRICE AS DETAIL_PRICE, D.BUY_NUM FROM SHOP_BUY B LEFT JOIN BUY_DETAIL D ON D.buy_num = B.buy_num WHERE B.BUY_NUM = #{buyNum}
